# B310 Next Step Plan
Дата: 13.09.2026

## Priority 1 — B311 policy-induced behavioral change
Construct controlled contexts where baseline action margins are near tie, train one action through verified outcomes, then measure future action distribution across repeated trials.

Stop condition: repeatable distribution shift in at least two independent contexts, with policy lesion returning the shift toward baseline.

## Priority 2 — source arbitration competition map
Use B310 sourceCredit + B309 redundancy diagnostics to identify which sources suppress the learned policy after B297. Do not increase coefficients blindly.

## Priority 3 — Android/Termux
Run `scripts/run-b305-termux-benchmark.sh` on the actual target phone and record RAM, CPU, thermal, latency and persistence payload.

## Priority 4 — verification closure
Turn critical unverified functions in final action arbitration, policy persistence and neural outcome routing into direct VERIFIED probes.

## Non-goals
- no second policy learner;
- no second personality ledger;
- no second neural substrate;
- no artificial consciousness claim;
- no coefficient inflation without causal benchmark evidence.
